newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain approves subsidies to replace old vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Spain approves subsidies to replace old vehicles.

text.p: The government has approved a new plan to provide subsidies for residents to replace vehicles, including motor cycles, of over 10 years with new ones, Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Friday.
"The government will give 80,000 pesetas ($565) to buy new vehicles if residents can present papers proving they have dumped their old vehicle," Pique told a news conference.
The government said the subsidies would not be a temporary measure.
"This is not a shock plan for a short period but is a permanent measure," Pique said.
Pique said the plan, known as the Structural Program for the Renovation of Vehicles (PREVER), was designed to boost the car sector, increase safety on the roads and for environmental reasons.
The subsidies will apply to all forms of vehicles including cars, tractors and motor cycles of up to 250 c.c.
For industrial vehicles of up to 6.5 tonnes, the subsidies would apply for vehicles of over seven years old, he said.
